File No: B. REGISTRY

Date June 19th 1933

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

Subject (in full) Communist Meeting in Western Chapei.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao-hwa. Forwarded by [Signature]

Agent D-4123 reports that at a meeting held by six
members of the "Federation of Shanghai Cotton Mill Workers"
on a piece of vacant ground to the West of Kiaochow Road,
Q.O.L., between 7.30 p.m. and 8.30 p.m. June 16, 1933, the
following resolutions were passed :-
(1) That a protest be lodged with the senior members of the
Party against the recent suspension of the payment of
"living expenses."
(2) That groups be formed to write communist propaganda on
walls.
(3) That members of the Federation of Shanghai Cotton Mill
Workers continue their activities irrespective of the
non-payment of living expenses.
(4) That the organization of more cells in industrial concerns
be intensified.

The meeting was presided over by Mah Siao Sz Ts (馬小四子),
a member of the Shanghai Western Special District Committee of
the local Chinese Communist Party whose description is given
hereunder :-
Age about 27/8; native of Kompo; height 5' 4";
round face; dark complexion; stout build; usually wears blue
cotton clothing.

Kuh Pao-hwa
I I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

17.6.33
